architecture.summary: Add .claude/** and ast-report/** to the excluded paths of the habit-hooks source file list in .habit-hooks/config.toml. A full scan (habit-hooks on main, or habit-hooks --all) reads every file under the project folder and ignores .gitignore, so it also scanned the gitignored agent worktrees (11,565 files) and review artifacts (193 files) in addition to the 1,361 tracked source files. A branch run takes its paths from git and does not change; hook.config.toml, the ESLint rules, the sensors, and the empty snooze file do not change. No production code, contract, dependency, composition, build output, or deployment relationship changes: nothing in src/, test/, the runtime images, or the workflows reads this file. The component registry describes the runtime system only; its prose and all 20 views remain accurate and unchanged.
